function.name: mcp__ast-ts-refactor__find_references
function.description: Find all places where a symbol is referenced in TypeScript code. Returns matching lines with context. Use when you need to locate usages of a function, class, variable, or interface.

symbol.description: The name of the symbol to find (e.g., 'parseConfig', 'UserService')

pattern.description: Optional regex pattern to refine matches

function.name: mcp__ast-ts-refactor__rename_symbol
function.description: Rename a symbol (function, class, variable, interface) across multiple files in a TypeScript project. Safely refactors all references. Use this when you need to rename something and keep all usages in sync.

scope.description: Optional scope filter (e.g., file path or module name)

function.name: mcp__ast-ts-refactor__extract_function
function.description: Extract selected code into a new function. Automatically detects parameters and return type. Use when refactoring duplicated logic or improving code organization.

start_line.description: Start line number of the code to extract

end_line.description: End line number of the code to extract
